name: Aqua-Terrarium 100x45x45/30 +3D
label: Large terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 100x45x45 cm with a handmade 3D background. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 30 cm.

description.html: This 100x45x45 cm aqua-terrarium is designed for animals that need both a dry and an aquatic environment. With a 30 cm water section and a total volume of 202.5 liters, it gives semi-aquatic species enough room for natural behavior: swimming, diving and climbing out onto land.

A length of 100 cm and a width of 45 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The ample length allows a temperature gradient from a warm to a cool zone, which every reptile needs to stay healthy. Mesh covers on the ventilation openings let air through but not food or the small inhabitants of the terrarium.
Aqua-terrariums are designed for species that need both a land and a water section in their habitat:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: When ordering, you choose the decorative film, the 3D background style and the ventilation type. Non-standard dimensions, LED lighting and a thermostat are available as options. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for full details. Delivery across Serbia.
